title.en: OpenAI introduces ChatGPT for Financial Services
title.zhHans: OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT for Financial Services

searchSummary.en: OpenAI introduced a tailored ChatGPT Work experience for financial institutions, with built-in financial data, GPT-6 Astra, and firm-controlled governance features.
searchSummary.zhHans: OpenAI 推出面向金融机构的定制版 ChatGPT Work，结合内置金融数据、GPT-6 Astra 和机构控制的治理功能。

summary.en: On September 10, OpenAI introduced ChatGPT for Financial Services, a tailored ChatGPT Work experience that combines built-in financial data with GPT-6 Astra for research, financial models, and client materials. Morgan Stanley and Evercore were named as design partners. CNBC reported that the initial focus is investment banking and equity research and that OpenAI had not disclosed broader signed-bank adoption.
summary.zhHans: 9 月 10 日，OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT for Financial Services，这是 ChatGPT Work 的定制体验，将内置金融数据与 GPT-6 Astra 结合，用于研究、财务模型和客户材料。OpenAI 将 Morgan Stanley 和 Evercore 列为设计合作伙伴。《CNBC》报道，产品初期聚焦投资银行和股票研究，OpenAI 尚未披露更广泛的签约银行采用情况。

narrative.en: The product connects a general enterprise assistant to data and templates controlled by financial institutions. OpenAI lists LSEG, Daloopa, Crunchbase, and PitchBook among the data sources available through the workflow, while firms retain control over access and governance. The launch is a product and distribution milestone, not evidence that financial institutions have broadly adopted the system or that junior bankers have been replaced. Design partnership, early availability, and provider-reported OfficeQA Pro results remain distinct from independent deployment evidence.
narrative.zhHans: 该产品将通用企业助手与金融机构控制的数据和模板连接起来。OpenAI 列出的工作流数据来源包括 LSEG、Daloopa、Crunchbase 和 PitchBook，同时由机构控制访问和治理。这次发布是产品和分发层面的里程碑，但不是金融机构已广泛采用该系统或初级银行家已被替代的证据。设计合作、早期可用性和厂商报告的 OfficeQA Pro 结果，也应与独立部署证据区分。

description.en: Packages financial research and presentation workflows around institution-controlled data, increasing the scope of repeatable knowledge work that an enterprise AI product targets.
description.zhHans: 围绕机构控制的数据打包金融研究和演示材料工作流，扩大了企业 AI 产品针对的可重复知识工作范围。

description.en: Makes a sector-specific AI workflow available to eligible financial institutions rather than limiting the offering to generic chat or bespoke internal systems.
description.zhHans: 向符合条件的金融机构提供行业专用 AI 工作流，而不是将能力限制在通用聊天或定制内部系统中。

text.en: OpenAI introduced ChatGPT for Financial Services on September 10 as a tailored ChatGPT Work experience built with design partners Morgan Stanley and Evercore.
text.zhHans: OpenAI 于 9 月 10 日推出 ChatGPT for Financial Services，这是与 Morgan Stanley 和 Evercore 合作设计的 ChatGPT Work 定制体验。

text.en: The product combines GPT-6 Astra with built-in financial data, citations, access controls, and firm-controlled templates for research and client materials.
text.zhHans: 该产品将 GPT-6 Astra 与内置金融数据、引用、访问控制和机构控制的模板结合，用于研究和客户材料。

text.en: Design partnership and early availability do not establish broad customer adoption, independent performance, or replacement of junior banking roles.
text.zhHans: 设计合作和早期可用性不能证明广泛客户采用、独立性能结果或初级银行岗位被替代。

editorial.reviewNotes: L1 enterprise product node. Design partners and provider-reported evaluations are not treated as broad adoption or independent performance evidence.
